subject: Request: Limited logo license & press-evidence checklist for pilot announcement
messages:
From: Sanjeev Rao <sanjeev@halcyon.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood pilot announcement — logo use + short checklist

Hi Mina —

Thanks again for the pilot run last quarter. The marketing team at Halcyon would like to include Redwood in a short announcement and request permission for logo use and a couple of on-record quotes. Before we finalize the PR schedule (tentative week of July 10), can you confirm: 

- A limited, non-exclusive logo license for web/press kit use only (90-day window)
- Whether Redwood requires an embargo date and approver for quote sign-off
- Any preferred wording for the Halcyon-blurb and attribution

I've attached our proposed blurbs and the primary logo. Can you point me to who at Redwood signs the press/asset license? Legal suggested we route any MSAR/Order Form publicity changes back to the contracting team but asked for a short checklist to speed review.

Appreciate it —
Sanjeev

Attachment: halcyon_press_blurbs.docx (docx)
Attachment: halcyon_logo_primary.svg (svg)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjeev Rao <sanjeev@halcyon.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Legal Ops <legal@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot announcement — logo use + short checklist

Hi Sanjeev —

Thanks — looping in Marissa (marketing lead) and Ben (contracts). Quick answers up front: we can usually do a 90-day limited logo license for press kits and web assets; we prefer an embargo to be explicit and require a single approver on the final quote (Marketing + Legal sign-off).

Action items from Redwood side: 
- Ben: will propose precise MSA/Order Form language (publicity clause carveout for limited license + duration).
- Marissa: will draft preferred attribution and a short approved blurb; also confirm which logo variant Halcyon may use.
- Mina: will confirm the approver list and timeline and provide the evidence checklist Legal wants (proof of placement, final URL, screenshot after live).

Two quick constraints to flag for Halcyon Legal: we request the right to rescind the license if branding is altered, and we ask that quotes attributed to Redwood be pre-approved (minor edits okay for grammar). If Halcyon needs broader reference rights beyond the 90 days we will need an Order Form amendment.

I'll await Ben's redline and Marissa's blurb.

Best,
Mina

Signature:
Mina Haddad
Senior Manager, Partnerships & Legal Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment stub: proposed-msar-redline-v3.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjeev Rao <sanjeev@halcyon.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Contracts <contracts@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 14:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot announcement — logo use + short checklist

Sanjeev / team —

Attached is a short redline to the MSAR publicity clause that adds a scoped, timeboxed license for logo and a required evidence deliverable. Summary of key points in the redline: 

1) Limited License: Halcyon may use Redwood "logos and mark variants" in Halcyon's press release and press kit, for web-based announcement and partner pages only, for a period of 90 days from first publication. No adaptations beyond size and color-preserving safe margin adjustments.

2) Quote Attribution: Any quote purporting to be from a Redwood employee requires prior approval; acceptance for minor edits to fix grammar/tense only.

3) Evidence & Audit: Halcyon must provide a link to the live announcement and a screenshot within 5 business days of publication. Failure to provide evidence allows Redwood to revoke the license.

4) Escalation / Exceptions: Any request for continuous reference rights or case study use beyond 90 days requires an Order Form amendment and commercial review (deal id included).

If Halcyon signs these limited terms we can provide a DocuSign envelope for the logo license addendum (no change to core commercial terms). If you want the broader 12-month reference right, we can propose a fee and a marketing review.

Ben
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed-msar-redline-v3.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjeev Rao <sanjeev@halcyon.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Jul 2028 08:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot announcement — logo use + short checklist

Hi Sanjeev —

Thanks for sending — I like the shorter 90-day window for the pilot announcement. Attached is an approved blurb we can sign off on and the preferred light-background logo. A couple of small asks: 

- Please use "Redwood Inference" (full name) on first mention; shorten to "Redwood" after that.
- For the quote, please use the exact line below — if you need edits, send them back and we'll approve quickly.
- Please do not use the logo in any third-party paid advertising or co-branded creative without prior permission.

Approved blurb (for copy/paste):
"Redwood Inference provided Halcyon with a private pilot to evaluate low-latency, cost-optimized LLM inference. The pilot demonstrated predictable latency at scale and operational controls that enabled Halcyon to reduce per-inference costs during peak traffic."

Quote (approved):
"We saw a measurable reduction in latency and predictable throughput during our pilot with Redwood, which made it straightforward to validate production readiness," said Alex Park, Head of Platform at Halcyon.

I'll give final sign-off once I see the mocked-up placement. Target embargo still looks like July 10 — please send a mock and DocuSign when ready.

Cheers,
Marissa
VP, Marketing Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: halcyon_logo_light.svg (svg)

From: Sanjeev Rao <sanjeev@halcyon.ai>

Team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and clear redlines. Halcyon Legal is comfortable with the 90-day limited license and the evidence requirement; we will not use the logo in paid co-branded ads. Halcyon PR will add your approved blurb and the exact quote as provided.

Next steps: 
- Halcyon will return a signed DocuSign logo license addendum by EOD 07/04.
- We will share the mocked placement by 07/06 for Marissa's final check.
- If all looks good, embargo lift = 07/10.

I'll attach the signed addendum and the mock once complete. Appreciate the quick collaboration.

Best,
Sanjeev
Halcyon AI
